name: Lightning Swift
effect: Deals additional Energy DMG to enemies attacked within 2 seconds of using Vanishing Step.
note: Activation: After using Vanishing Step. Can activate once every 6 seconds.

name: Super Snowball
effect: Boosts the power of all attacks whenever you score a KO or assist on an enemy hero.
note: Activation: Enemy hero KO or assist. Grants 25 All Attack Up per stack, up to 8 stacks. All stacks are lost when you are KO'd.

name: Build Up
effect: Boosts all defenses whenever you score enough KOs or assists on enemy NPCs.
note: Activation: Every 5 enemy NPC KOs or assists. Grants 22 All Defense Up per stack, up to 10 stacks.

name: Angelic Blessing
note: Activation: When recovering in an allied God of Destruction area.

name: Rocket Booster
effect: Shortens the time needed to enter high-speed movement.

name: High Intensity
effect: Reduces charging time for Gekishin Burst (excluding Max Gekishin Burst).
note: Activation: Every KO or assist on an enemy hero.

name: Giant Slayer
effect: Boosts damage dealt to an enemy hero in proportion to their maximum HP.
note: Activation: Hit an enemy hero while they have 80% or more HP. The effect applies to that target until the confrontation ends.

name: Gutsy
effect: Reduces maximum total HP and boosts the power of all attacks.

name: Deep Grudge
note: Activation: When hit by an enemy hero or companion attack.

name: Adrenaline Power
effect: Reduces initial damage on hit and takes the reduced amount of damage over time.
note: Activation: When hit by an attack (excluding God of Destruction attacks).

name: Ninja Concealment Arts
note: Activation: When close to a boss.

name: Heal Block
effect: The target enemy hero loses extra HP and is prevented from recovering total HP (unless transformed) or gaining extra HP.
note: Activation: Hit an enemy hero whose combined Base HP and Armor is 30% or lower with a Skill.

name: Super Charge
note: Activation: Every KO on an enemy hero.

name: Stealth Attack
effect: For a set period, you cannot be discovered by enemies, and hitting an enemy hero with a Skill grants extra DMG.
note: Activation: Every KO or assist on an enemy hero.

name: Defense Step
effect: Reduces damage from enemy heroes for 4 seconds after using Vanishing Step. The effect is much stronger against Super Attacks and decreases over time.
note: Activation: After using Vanishing Step. Internal cooldown: 12 seconds.

name: Turtle Shell
effect: Extends the cooldown of Vanishing Step and boosts maximum total HP.

name: Limit-Breaking Jump
effect: Lets you use Vanishing Step one additional time while its normal cooldown is still active.
note: Activation: Vanishing Step is on cooldown. Can activate once every 6 seconds.

name: Full Throttle
effect: Boosts maximum movement speed during high-speed movement.
